teams.name: Marching Band
teams.description: Band continues to conduct weekly practices online with a focus on individual coaching and self-improvement. The band meets weekly on Mondays from 1900-2000 hrs. Cadets who are interested in joining the band and own their own instruments are welcome to join.

teams.name: Flag Party
teams.description: Flag party will practice in-person when able. Online resources will also be used.

teams.name: Drill Team
teams.description: Drill team tryout will commence when in-person training resumes. Practices are planned for Friday evenings.

teams.name: Pilot Training (Ground School)
teams.description: Power and Glider Training Courses may be offered next summer pending further communications. Ground school is delivered virtually.

teams.name: Drone Training
teams.description: Opportunities to be trained and certified for flying drones. A Transport Canada exam is required for either Basic (age 14+) and Advanced operations (age 16+).

teams.name: Marksmanship Team
teams.description: Competitions proceed with modifications. After initial training (air rifle safe handle test), new cadets can tryout for competition teams. The squadron is allocated 3 teams of 5 members for the championship series.

teams.name: Biathlon Team
teams.description: Biathlon training and team selection commence when in-person training resumes. Practices are traditionally Friday evenings and weekends before competitions in January.

teams.name: Sports Team
teams.description: Fitness training focuses on an innovative and flexible format.

teams.name: Effective Speaking Team
teams.description: An opportunity to learn and improve public speaking skills, including prepared and impromptu speeches, with guidance from Toastmasters International instructors.

teams.name: Debate Team
teams.description: Debate Team utilizes a virtual platform and typically starts after the Effective Speaking program.
